description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing its content along with some test-related functionalities. It includes implementation of 'read_file_into_memory' to open, read, and store file contents in a buffer, and 'print_input_output' to display file contents and data. The code also includes logging calls for error reporting.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the content of a specified file into a provided memory structure, handling file opening, reading, and buffer allocation.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the content of a file and/or a given KVP data string to the console, utilizing the 'read_file_into_memory' function if necessary.
